_comment: ROADMAP 3 — the closed, growing list of things a plan may do. The translator picks from these; it cannot invent a field. Each action names the mechanism it touches, so every simulated plan is explainable. Phrases are hints for the model and for tests, not a grammar.

set_open.mechanism: hours disruption; who is shut out at their usual time

set_price.mechanism: price disruption at the regular shop; price cost in reappraisal

add_item.mechanism: product availability; a new usual_order candidate

drop_item.mechanism: product disruption for anyone whose usual item disappears

set_wait.mechanism: wait disruption; wait cost in reappraisal

set_marketing_message.mechanism: the line non-regulars read in the options block

restore.mechanism: undo a change made earlier in this scenario chain (unset to the base value)

shop_enters.mechanism: the shop does not exist before that day (not an option, no marketing, no habit); on the day it opens, a new_entrant shock and an opening-day curiosity bump for people within 2x their walk tolerance. Forces a full rerun from day 1.
phrases: Starbucks opens across the street on day 4
the other shop only arrives on day 3

unsupported_examples.reason: no persona state for accumulated rewards yet (roadmap D2)
no mechanism for distance or wait removal per person yet (roadmap D3)
nothing in a persona perceives events; would be opinion, not behaviour
the simulation has no weekdays; every day is a weekday

unsupported_examples.text: I am opening a new shop in this town
unsupported_examples.reason: launching the focus shop itself is a different mechanism (roadmap C); shop_enters is for a competitor only
